pairs.subject: correlated-exchange-over-broadcast
pairs.evidence: src/app/api/events/stream/route.ts:13 This context only relays and visualizes a one-way event stream: the route pipes upstream SSE bytes to the browser and the components project the event store. Nothing here sends a request and waits for its reply, runs a goal, or holds a correlation id, so the subject's precondition (request/reply or goal/result on a broadcast bus) does not hold. A case-insensitive grep of the context's files plus src/components/dashboard, src/app/api/events, src/lib/types.ts and src/stores/eventStore.ts found no replyTo, reply_to, correlation_id, in_reply_to, goal_status, goal_id or awaitReply, and PersonaEvent carries no correlation field.

techniques.evidence: src/app/api/events/stream/route.ts:142 The relay loop forwards every upstream chunk without filtering. There is no targeted wait that could swallow unrelated traffic.

src/components/dashboard/views/events/useScopedEvents.ts:18 The client reads the whole event log by persona and time window. It never issues requests, so it has no replies of its own to filter by correlation id.
src/components/dashboard/EventBusVisualization.tsx:28 The visualization groups events by source type only. No metadata keys mark correlated exchanges, and no predicate classifies correlated traffic.
src/components/dashboard/EventDetailDrawer.tsx:50 The status shown here is an active/idle display derived from traffic volume. It is not a goal status that ends a correlated wait.
